title: hersona Persona Pack
description: Recipe catalog for hersona persona packs (PR-B W1, docs/PERSONA_PACKS_DESIGN.md §2). A pack names a blend of real attributes + a weight + an optional use_case; the actual injection block is rendered at install time from the named attributes (so attribute updates propagate automatically and the build_site.py drift gate stays irrelevant).

persona_name.description: Pack identifier used as the agent.personalities.<name> registry key. Snake_case, ASCII only, starts with a lowercase letter.

display_name.description: Display name in the BASE language (en). Localized overrides go under i18n.<lang>.display_name.

description.description: Short description of what this pack composes (BASE = en). Localized overrides go under i18n.<lang>.description.

blend.description: Attribute references in <category>/<name> form (e.g. 'personality/diligent'). At least one. Each reference must resolve to a real attribute under attributes/ (enforced semantically by validate_persona, not by JSON Schema).

weight.description: Intensity dial applied to the whole blend at install time. Mirrors the attribute YAML weight_dimension vocabulary.

use_case.description: Optional Operating Mode ID; the pack installs the use_case block alongside the blend. Must resolve to a real use_case under use_cases/ (enforced semantically).

tags.description: Cross-cutting search tags (kebab-case). Empty array allowed.

i18n.description: Localized metadata overrides keyed by language code (e.g. ja). Each value may override display_name / description for that language.
